newsitem.title: GREECE: DELTA SECURITIES OFFICIALS STILL UNAVAILABLE.
newsitem.headline: DELTA SECURITIES OFFICIALS STILL UNAVAILABLE.

text.p: Officials at Athens stock exchange member firm Delta Securities which was barred from trading again on Thursday for non-compliance with settlement regulations were unavailable for comment.
An unidentified woman at the company's offices told Reuters the whereabouts of Dimitris Argyriadis, board chairman and Spyros Aloupis, the firm's registered representative were unknown.
"For us the office is operating normally. We (unidentified number of staff) are here and we'll be here tomorrow. Call tomorrow," she said refusing to identify herself.

Meanwhile, retail shareholder association president Dimitris Karagounis told Flash radio station the bourse should close for two or three days to allow the clearing house to catch up and sort out non-compliance cases. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
